relevant_laws.quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: After entering the intersection, the left turn must be made so as to leave the intersection to the right of the centerline of the highway being entered.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: post-entry left-turn departure position at two two-directional highways
relevant_laws.notes: Original highway/intersection status, full-body departure and statutory meaning of right of centerline require source review; no legal verdict assigned.
